purpose: First independent check on the N=50 campaign after another lane launched it. Written before reporting, because a determination that exists only in chat is not discharged (BEN-139, this lane's own finding).
scope: Observation only. This lane did NOT launch the campaign, has not modified it, and is not proposing to.
VERDICT: The campaign is doing what its name says: the coherent bootstrap is drawing DISTINCT measured targets per replica, and the realized seeds match the declared policy. No defect found.

THE_CHECK_THAT_MATTERED_MOST.question: Are the replica targets actually DIFFERENT from each other and from the nominal? If they were identical the measured-side variance would be collapsed, C_stat would come out ~zero, and it would read as a reassuringly SMALL statistical component rather than as a broken draw.
THE_CHECK_THAT_MATTERED_MOST.why_it_is_the_first_thing_to_check: That is the same shape as five byte-identical sstat rows and as the 28,672 B x 240 uniformity: the wrong answer is more persuasive than the right one, because a small statistical component is exactly what everyone expects to see.

measured.reading: Same byte count because the measured inventory is the same 4,680,719 rows; different content because the Poisson factors differ per replica. Identical size with different digests is exactly the right signature.

SEED_POLICY_REALIZED_MATCHES_DECLARED.consequence: These receipts are what assert_refined_target_is_replica validates at train time -- the receipt's bootstrap_seed against the seed the loader is drawing. That function had ZERO production callers until this campaign; it now has two, on the path that needed it.

ARRAY_STATE.sacct_vs_squeue: AGREE -- both report the same five RUNNING tasks. An apparent disagreement in my first read was my own `head -6` truncating squeue's output, not a disagreement between the tools.
ARRAY_STATE.target_build_wall: ~39 min per replica, FASTER than the 55:32 nominal Gate-2 precedent. Not investigated; noted so nobody treats 55 min as the per-replica figure.

CODE_IDENTITY_IS_STRUCTURALLY_PROTECTED_.finding: The campaign execs from GATE5_CODE_ROOT=/pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/gate6traj-reconcile-56847059, which is NOT the repo tree, with six digests locked in the Slurm job environment at submit (HEAD, INPUT, TARGET_DRIVER, TRAIN_DRIVER, NOMINAL_DRIVER, LOADER). CODE_ROOT's loader is e1402370 -- this lane's edit -- matching GATE5_EXPECTED_LOADER_SHA exactly.
CODE_IDENTITY_IS_STRUCTURALLY_PROTECTED_.so: Editing the repo tree cannot reach these members, and editing the launcher cannot reach the queued array because Slurm captured its own copy of the batch script at submit. The Gate-6 code-split failure mode is prevented, by a private CODE_ROOT rather than by pet/snapshot_array_code.sh.
CODE_IDENTITY_IS_STRUCTURALLY_PROTECTED_.my_earlier_concern_was_scoped_wrong: I twice raised the missing snapshot wiring as a campaign exposure. It was a real gap in the LAUNCHER and not in the CAMPAIGN, because I assessed the launcher's text and inferred the campaign's behaviour from it. BEN-148 in my own hand: I enumerated what the launcher names and mistook it for what the campaign does. The answer only ever lived in the job environment, which no `git grep` can see.
CODE_IDENTITY_IS_STRUCTURALLY_PROTECTED_.the_one_residual_and_it_is_coordination_: CODE_ROOT is named for a DIFFERENT job's reconcile work (gate6traj-reconcile-56847059), and that trajectory array is COMPLETE -- so its owner may reasonably treat the directory as disposable while a ~35 h campaign depends on it. A cleanup would fail the sha guards (safe) and kill the campaign (expensive, because Gate 5's BLOCK rule makes one missing replica invalidate the manifest).
CODE_IDENTITY_IS_STRUCTURALLY_PROTECTED_.a_mitigation_I_proposed_and_WITHDREW: chmod -R a-w on CODE_ROOT. Withdrawn on measurement: four .pyc files postdate the submit (03:54-03:55, cpython-311, the ROOT env's Python), so members are actively writing pycache there; and there is ZERO cpython-39 cache while the TF module gives Python 3.9.18, so all 50 train members would start cold and attempt writes. Making the tree read-only would alter the behaviour of jobs already in flight. Caught by the mediator's caveat, confirmed by measurement, withdrawn.

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: That the campaign will pass. Two of fifty targets are complete and no training has started.
That the replica targets are CORRECT -- only that they are distinct, correctly seeded, and self-reported PASS. Distinctness is not correctness.
Anything about C_stat. It needs 50 of 50, and Gate 5's own rule is that a missing replica invalidates the manifest rather than yielding a 49-replica ensemble.
That the snapshot mechanism is unnecessary in general -- only that this campaign's code identity is protected without it.
